title: Emil of Lönneberga
author: Astrid Lindgren
short_summary: Emil is a mischievous but good-hearted farm boy in the Swedish village of Lönneberga. Every time he gets into one of his scrapes — and there are many — his father locks him in the tool shed to think about what he's done. Emil doesn't mind much, since it gives him time to carve little wooden men out of blocks of wood.
extended_summary:
Emil is a mischievous but good-hearted farm boy in the Swedish village of Lönneberga. Every time he gets into one of his scrapes — and there are many — his father locks him in the tool shed to think about what he's done. Emil doesn't mind much, since it gives him time to carve little wooden men out of blocks of wood.

Emil's mishaps range from getting his head stuck in a soup tureen at a fair to accidentally "selling" his own father at an auction while play-acting. But when a snowstorm threatens the life of Alfred, the farmhand Emil loves like family, Emil risks everything to drag him through the storm to a doctor — proving that underneath all the trouble, he has one of the kindest hearts in the village.
